description:
Goal

Make ordinary pull products revisioned derived values: every product answer is fresh by construction from exact product and fact reads, including cache hits, without product-specific freshness caches.

Signal

- A producer read context records produced child generations, missing child waits, and fact revisions/readiness under the current parent key.
- Waiting retains dependency edges; a concluding production replaces them.
- Product generations advance only when immutable ProductValue changes.
- A stale deepest child re-produces before its parent. Equal child reproduction preserves parent and grandparent cache/generations.
- A changed child invalidates only direct readers; propagation continues only when a reader itself concludes with a changed value.
- Forward/reverse wait service yields identical values, generations, and dependencies.

Strategy

1. Replace ProductMemo value-only entries with immutable value, generation, and exact dependency metadata plus reverse readers.
2. Route ordinary production product/fact reads through one explicit ProductReadContext; direct memo cache-hit reads and unstamped facts are not dependencies.
3. Treat returned waits as scheduling output from the same recorded missing reads, not as the dependency store.
4. Validate dependencies before cache hits and schedule the deepest stale product. Preserve generations across equal recomputation.
5. Publish every RuntimeDemand and ExecutableEffects non-anchor SCC/cone member with the completed producer dependency set; the requested anchor finishes normally through the driver.
6. Migrate ordinary product producers and delete superseded artifact/runtime-demand freshness paths rather than keeping parallel mechanisms.

Proven transport scope boundary

The current TransportComponent producer side-computes a whole solved closure containing many unrelated component values. Its consumed_fact_revisions ledger validates that broader side inventory, not only the requested component ProductValue.

A proposed dependency on the first requested component is unsound: that anchor component can re-produce an equal value while another side-produced component changes. The unchanged anchor generation cannot validate the changed side inventory. Making the whole closure a ProductValue would canonize the pass; publishing every unrelated component as if requested would bless overproduction and duplicate storage.

Therefore this ticket does not add a closure anchor, closure product, or fake component publications. The legacy consumed_fact_revisions/closure consult ledger remains isolated until fz-k22.5 replaces whole-closure reuse with exact position products and deletes it. This is a proven atomic boundary, not permission for new code to use the legacy model.

Required removals in this commit

- root_artifact_revisions and materialized_world_revisions freshness side channels;
- ProductProducers fact_revision/root_artifact_revision/executable_artifact_revisions cache-hit hooks;
- DemandFactsCache revision stamping where the generic context now owns the same ordinary product reads;
- ordinary production session.memo().get reads outside ProductReadContext;
- transitive invalidation on staleness rather than changed value.

Acceptance

Permanent real-driver tests prove cache-hit and missing child dependencies, fact revision movement, retraction, equal-value stability across three levels, exact direct-reader invalidation, waiting/conclusion dependency replacement, side-published SCC member dependencies, cycle/reentry behavior, and schedule independence. cargo test --lib and deny-warning clippy pass. Documentation explains both the generic product dependency contract and the isolated legacy transport exception. No frontier, edge-value, or callable behavior from later tickets is implemented here.

Hidden artifact cycle removed

The explicit dependency migration proved that TransportComponent/TransportShape opportunistically read MaterializedExecutable.body and original_entry_ids, while MaterializedExecutable itself waits on TransportShape. That is a schedule-dependent product cycle, not a valid optional optimization.

Transport already has the authoritative inputs: LoweredBody plus ActivationAnalysis reachable clauses/entries and exact CallSiteSummary facts. This ticket removes the materialized-product/inventory read and derives transport only from those upstream authorities. It does not copy, reconstruct, or preserve the artifact cycle. Permanent tests must prove first solve and re-solve select identical transport context from the same upstream facts.

Transport side-effect ownership correction

The migration also proved that TransportComponent owns recorded layouts while TransportShape only projects them. Legacy stale-shape cleanup deleted the component-owned layout, then re-produced the shape as AbsentForClosure. This ticket narrows shape cleanup to shape-owned absence records; component/closure invalidation remains the layout owner. It adds no new lifetime bridge.

Shared executable-facts product

Removing DemandFactsCache exposed that RuntimeDemand and OutgoingInputEdges repeatedly derive the same immutable executable fact bundle. A representative schedule-independence test regressed from 48.81s real / 47.67s user to 132.20s real / 131.28s user. Restoring a session cache with its own stamp protocol would recreate the model this ticket removes.

This ticket instead makes that bundle one request-local product, derived only from ActivationAnalyzed(E), LoweredBody(function), EntryDispatch(function), and the executable call sites exact CallSiteSummary facts. Both consumers read that product through ProductReadContext. It has no sealing phase, inventory scan, or downstream artifact dependency; its generation advances only when its immutable value changes. The old DemandFactsCache stays deleted.

Acceptance additionally requires the representative timing to return to the pre-change range or improve, with identical values and dependency behavior in forward and reverse schedules.

Proven exact movement delivery requirement

One-drive counters isolate the regression. The pre-change driver completes in 15.52s test / 21.05s real / 23.00s user. The first revisioned-product implementation completes in 75.00s test / 80.90s real / 83.75s user and performs 4,693,565 recursive product validations plus 14,733,148 fact-state reads for only 117 genuinely stale products. Per-producer validation memoization is insufficient because the knowledge is discarded between top-level pulls.

Scheduler::complete already computes the authoritative FactChange wave, including exact key, revision, and readiness movement. AppliedStep.changed currently retains only direct replacement changes while dirtied-readiness and recursively induced movements are consumed for wakes and discarded; preserve that full wave under a distinct contract. Do not collapse that precision to a global scalar and later rescan/reconstruct relevance. ProductMemo indexes exact fact readers. The product-drive completion path passes the existing FactChange values by reference to the driver, which invalidates only direct product readers whose recorded FactUse state moved. Product-generation propagation remains value-driven: a fact movement schedules its direct readers, and their readers move only if the re-produced immutable ProductValue changes.

Any scalar generation may only guard exact change delivery or identify a cursor gap; it cannot become freshness authority or trigger dependency-tree rescanning. Prove every production path that completes World work while a ProductDriver is live delivers the exact changes, including the direct re-publication path used by permanent retraction tests.

Acceptance additionally requires one-drive counters to collapse redundant recursive validation/fact-state reads while preserving all genuine stale invalidations, followed by the three-drive timing at or below the pre-change range. Temporary counters and probes are removed before commit.

Proven completion boundary

The root drivers used by BuildBackendProduct and LowerNativeProgram are dropped before their enclosing job completion, so no outer live memo misses those completions. An outer fact wait can run BuildMacroExecutable, whose nested root driver completes internal work while the outer driver remains live; those internal activation/callsite facts are keyed by a distinct RootId, absent shared function facts can only belong to pending products, and existing shared LoweredBody/EntryDispatch facts are immutable during the nested drive. Therefore no already-produced outer memo entry can be stale from an internal macro-root completion. The enclosing MacroExecutable completion is its first relevant outer movement. Permanent coverage must retain this root-disjointness premise or compose the movement observer if that premise changes.

Demand-local dirty propagation

Exact fact movement displaces only direct fact readers and propagates a dirty-descendant marker through reverse product edges without invalidating ancestor values or generations. Pulling a key follows only its dirty dependency edges to the deepest displaced product on that requested dependency path; unrelated stale session history is not refreshed. Equal reproduction clears that path without moving readers. Changed reproduction displaces only direct product readers and continues the value-change wave. This preserves demand minimality while eliminating recursive fact-state validation.
title: Make pull products revisioned values with exact dependency reads
